en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a fortified stone complex with a tall round tower on the right and a distinctive onion‑domed roof on the left. The scene includes old masonry walls, an arched gate, a path curving through a grassy courtyard, and several mature trees. The print has deckle‑style edges typical of vintage postcards. No visible caption or inscription is present on the image side.
